narrative: The Dev Box gives the managed-fleet capex thesis its concrete endpoint: a 1-petaflop, 128 GB local-inference box managed for organizations through Entra ID and Intune, the exact corporate-fleet surface a frontier-grade local-inference budget would land inside. That advances the device leg of the premise but only at product availability, not the capex-disclosure signal the prediction is keyed to.
remaining_gap: No Fortune 500 unified AI-infrastructure capex line bundling AI-PC fleet refresh with data-center spend, and no Big Four advisory RFP template under that framing.
